rationale: Adds history-derived timeout-minutes to release-cli.yml, sign-and-release.yml and auto-release.yml jobs and long steps, a lint that enforces them, and a one-time in-place rerun of a timed-out leg in the release reconciler. Step names, commands, build inputs, artifacts and packaging are unchanged; only how long a hung step may run and how the reconciler retries it change, so no design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves.
